title: Operation Radar: 266 suspects arrested in online-fraud crackdown across 14 countries, per Brazil's Federal Police and El Comercio
date_note: Date Brazil's Federal Police announced the operation, per SBT News; the sources give different operation periods (SBT: May to September; El Comercio: 1 May to 16 November 2026).
geo_basis: Federal Police headquarters; the operation spans 14 countries
summary: SBT News, citing Brazil's Federal Police, reports that 266 suspects were arrested in Operation Radar against online fraud, covering 14 countries in Latin America and Europe. According to the police, Brazilian actions deactivated eight domains used for electronic fraud, and most investigated cases were electronic scams. El Comercio reports four of the arrests were in Ecuador.
plain: Police in 14 countries say 266 suspects were arrested in a joint crackdown on online fraud such as electronic scams.
exec: Online-fraud networks are being targeted across borders, per Brazil's Federal Police.

evidence.quote: Detienen a 266 sospechosos de estafas en línea y fraude en 14 países

validation.note: SBT News (relaying the Federal Police) and El Comercio both state 266 arrests in 14 countries; they differ on the operation period. Neither page is the police's own.

review.note: Compared 266 arrests, 14 countries, eight domains, Ecuador four arrests against SBT News and El Comercio
